comments.body: Tried making butter chicken using a recipe I found here. Honestly, I didn't expect it to turn out this good on my first attempt!
replies: Butter chicken is one of my favourites! Did you use fresh cream?
Yes! Added a little extra cream at the end.
Try adding a little kasuri methi next time. Makes a big difference!

comments.body: The homemade pizza recipe is surprisingly easy. I always thought making pizza dough would be difficult, but it wasn't!
replies: Homemade pizza is so much better when you can choose your own toppings!

comments.body: Guys, if you haven't tried Korean fried chicken yet, you're seriously missing out. The sweet and spicy sauce is incredible.
Made vegetable fried rice for lunch today. Added some spring onions and extra garlic. Simple recipe but tastes amazing!
I finally learned how to make proper fluffy pancakes. The trick is apparently not to overmix the batter. Wish I knew this earlier.
Anyone else loves experimenting with different pasta sauces? I tried spinach and garlic sauce yesterday and it was surprisingly good.
replies: You should try adding mushrooms too!
That's actually a great idea. Trying it this weekend.

comments.body: Made homemade chocolate brownies for the first time. Crispy edges and a soft centre. Definitely saving this recipe!
Quick question: can I replace paneer with tofu in a paneer tikka recipe? Trying to experiment with different ingredients.
My mom's homemade masala dosa is still unbeatable, but I'm slowly learning to make it myself. Getting the dosa batter right is the hardest part.
Small cooking tip: always roast your spices on low heat. Burning them can completely change the flavour of your dish.
replies: Learned this the hard way while making biryani 😭

comments.body: Made a mango smoothie with banana and yoghurt this morning. Three ingredients and breakfast was sorted.
I recently tried making homemade momos. Folding them properly takes practice, but the result was worth it!
replies: Same! Mine looked more like little bags than momos 😂

comments.body: Is there anyone who actually measures ingredients when making Maggi? I just add whatever I find in the fridge.
Tried a simple garlic bread recipe today. Used regular sandwich bread instead of a baguette and it still turned out really nice.
Chicken biryani takes time, but honestly, the aroma when you finally open the pot is worth every minute.
For anyone trying to eat more vegetables, roasted vegetable wraps are a great option. Easy to prepare and you can use almost anything.
I added cheese to my regular aloo paratha today. Not traditional at all, but it tasted ridiculously good.
What's your favourite quick evening snack? I'm getting tired of eating the same sandwiches every day.
replies: Try making crispy corn. It's really easy!
Masala cheese toast is my go-to.
Both sound good. Adding them to my list!

comments.body: Made homemade chole today. Letting the masala cook properly before adding the chickpeas makes such a difference.
Does anyone have a good eggless cake recipe? Every time I try one, the texture turns out a little too dense.
Tried making restaurant-style garlic naan at home using a regular pan. It actually worked! No fancy equipment needed.
One thing I love about cooking at home is being able to adjust the spice level. My family likes everything extra spicy!
Made a simple tomato soup and grilled cheese combo yesterday. Perfect comfort food for a lazy evening.
replies: That's one of the best combinations ever.

comments.body: Just discovered how easy homemade ice cream can be. Tried a chocolate version and already planning a mango one next!
